acceptance_checks.description: ow_tp_demo.documents holds exactly 2000 documents, recomputed from Atlas
The total number of embedded versions across all documents is exactly 13876
Order-independent md5 over the migrated document and version line formats equal manifest checksums e70001cf6110014dab6e1d80adb40285 and 13bc033b2780a0569d7f2217e85d7303
All 390 snapshots are migrated and each references its document by id; snapshots are not embedded
The 10 documents whose version numbers are non-contiguous are reported by document id, with the missing version numbers enumerated, and are migrated as-is rather than renumbered
The 6 snapshots whose document_id has no parent document are reported by snapshot id and are not attached to any document
A second migration run leaves counts, checksums and the reported anomaly sets byte-identical

planted_anomalies.description: 10 documents have gaps in their version sequence; the gaps must be detected and reported, never closed by renumbering
6 document_snapshots rows reference a non-existent document and must be detected and reported, never attached to a synthesized parent

encoding_policy.input_encoding: UTF-8 as read through psycopg2 from the UTF8 database
encoding_policy.byte_transparency: Titles, bodies and metadata are carried through unchanged; timestamps are converted to BSON dates in UTC without shifting the instant
encoding_policy.invalid_bytes: A value that cannot be decoded is quarantined with the raw bytes hex-encoded; it is never replaced by a lossy substitute character

malformed_record_policy.details: Version gaps and orphaned snapshots are tolerated and attributed into the anomaly report because they are properties of the estate, not of the record encoding. A NULL or missing required source value fails that record into quarantine and may never fail open into a plausible default.

empty_input_semantics.details: A run that reads zero source rows leaves prior Atlas output untouched and exits non-zero; an empty read at demo scale is a source-connectivity failure.
